Remark
[large velocity]

↗ lem:dc-ch3-2-6

1. ch3:2.8By an analogous argument, one can make the velocity of a geodesic uniformly large in a neighborhood of $p$: the exact rescaling $I_{\max }(p,\, a\, v)=\{ t:\ a\, t\in I_{\max }(p,v)\} $ of the maximal interval trades interval length against velocity in both directions.
